name: Hrizantema
source:
They say the first love is always doomed. Not only will it hurt, but it will leave an indelible mark on your heart.

When you're a girl with unusual abilities, does it get more complicated, or is it the other way around?

Either way, G won't back down. She'll gather her courage and confess to her high school chemistry teacher. She's only a year away from graduation and their paths will be parted forever.

After all, Sensei also possesses unusual powers. It doesn't matter that there are other holders of special powers living nearby. G believes that only she and Sensei should have a special chemistry.

...Right?

[Translated from [url=https://onecell.itch.io/gidreams]itch.io[/url]]
